slides.title: 7 hooks that stop the **scroll**
slides.sub: Steal these for your next LinkedIn or Instagram carousel.

slides.title: The contrarian
slides.body: “Everyone says post daily. I posted 3 times a month and grew faster.” Tension makes people swipe.

slides.title: The number
slides.body: “7 mistakes”, “3 templates”, “48 hours”. A number promises a finite, scannable payoff.

slides.title: The mistake
slides.body: “You’re using carousels wrong.” Loss aversion beats curiosity.

slides.label: more reach for carousels than **single images** on Instagram

slides.text: People don’t read carousels. They swipe until something makes them stop.
